purpose: Construct the smallest covariant same-metric vector-scalar architecture that preserves the quadrature static force, gives matter and photons the same leading lensing shift, and repairs the fixed-aether scalar cone without hiding the remaining vector, endpoint, Solar, GW, and cosmological gates.

restricted_action_contract.fields: Einstein metric g_munu, unit timelike vector U^mu with g_munu U^mu U^nu=-1, scalar phi, Lagrange multiplier lambda_U, and universally coupled matter/photon fields
restricted_action_contract.scalar_invariants: Z=h^munu nabla_mu(phi)nabla_nu(phi)/(Mpl^2 a0^2), W=U^mu nabla_mu(phi)/(Mpl a0), s=alpha sqrt(Z), varphi=alpha phi/Mpl
restricted_action_contract.scalar_density: L_phi=2 Mpl^2 a0^2 p(-Z/2)+Mpl^2 a0^2 A(s,varphi) W^2
restricted_action_contract.kinetic_functions: p(s)=s^2/4+s/4+ln(1-2s)/8; C(s)=alpha^2 s/(1-2s); K(s)=2 alpha^2 s(1-s)/(1-2s)^2; A(s,varphi)=exp(-4varphi)K(s)
restricted_action_contract.vector_density: L_U=-(Mpl^2/2) K^{ab}_{mn}(c1,c2,c3,c4) nabla_a U^m nabla_b U^n+lambda_U(U^2+1)
restricted_action_contract.branch_domain: alpha>0, 0<s<1/2, finite real varphi, and a static U-orthogonal scalar gradient for the exact force branch
restricted_action_contract.novelty_boundary: This is a known TeVeS-type universal vector-metric architecture specialized to the frozen quadrature kinetic map; no historical novelty is claimed.

universal_metric_contract.universality: The same gtilde is used for massive matter, clocks, photons, and every lensing observable; no photon-only factor or post-fit lensing rescaling exists.
universal_metric_contract.weak_field_potentials: For U aligned with static time, Phi_tilde=Phi_E+varphi and Psi_tilde=Psi_E+varphi at first order.
universal_metric_contract.motion_lensing_relation: g_phi=d_r varphi=a0 s and d_r[(Phi_tilde+Psi_tilde)-(Phi_E+Psi_E)]=2g_phi, exactly the leading GR-equivalent lensing shift for the same scalar motion enhancement.
universal_metric_contract.source_scope: The nonrelativistic dust variation gives Q_phi=alpha rho/Mpl at leading weak-field order; no exact strong-field matter-source identity is claimed.

fixed_aether_scalar_principal_contract.scope: constant local g and U, static W=0 background, frozen vector perturbations, and scalar perturbations resolved parallel/transverse to the spatial background gradient
fixed_aether_scalar_principal_contract.principal_equation: -A partial_t^2 delta_phi+K partial_parallel^2 delta_phi+C partial_transverse^2 delta_phi=0
fixed_aether_scalar_principal_contract.physical_photon_speed: c_photon^2=exp(4varphi) in the local Einstein-frame U-rest coordinates
fixed_aether_scalar_principal_contract.conditional_result: The fixed-aether scalar block is causal relative to the physical photon cone on 0<s<1/2: longitudinal characteristics coincide and transverse characteristics lie strictly inside.
fixed_aether_scalar_principal_contract.full_system_limit: Vector perturbations couple through Z and W, so this does not establish the characteristic cone, constraints, or strong hyperbolicity of the full metric-vector-scalar-matter system.

gw_solar_cosmology_contract.tensor_condition: The Einstein-aether tensor cone is g-null only after the necessary c13=c1+c3=0 specialization in the adopted convention.
gw_solar_cosmology_contract.asymptotic_cone_ratio: With c13=0, c_GW/c_photon=exp(-2varphi_infinity) in the U-rest frame.
gw_solar_cosmology_contract.boundary_choice: varphi_infinity=0 passes the local algebraic cone condition but is not an on-shell cosmological solution or a proof that the bound holds along a real multimessenger path.
gw_solar_cosmology_contract.remaining_gates: Vector spin-1/spin-0 health, PPN preferred-frame parameters, Solar screening, strong fields, a global scalar endpoint completion, FLRW evolution, cutoff, and joint observational viability remain unproved.

obstruction_contract.low_gradient: C,K,A vanish as s approaches zero, so the exact deep-gradient branch remains strongly degenerate.
obstruction_contract.finite_gradient_endpoint: C,K,A diverge as s approaches one half, so the high-source endpoint remains singular.
obstruction_contract.cosmology: A homogeneous Z=0 scalar background sits on the degenerate s=0 boundary; no healthy timelike cosmological scalar branch is supplied.
obstruction_contract.vector_mixing: The fixed-aether cone calculation omits principal mixing with the dynamical unit vector and metric constraints.
obstruction_contract.interpretation: The architecture repairs the leading motion-lensing relation and the frozen-vector scalar cone, but is not a completed healthy gravity theory.
